item.title: Negotiating With a Predator: Why Talks With Russia Are Structurally Impossible
item.description: Every round of talks with Putin's Russia is a performance staged for a single overseas spectator and a smokescreen for the killing that continues underneath. You cannot negotiate while waging war, and Moscow's true precondition is not a compromise but the disappearance of Ukraine as a state.

item.title: The War Will Be Decided on the Battlefield, Not at the Table
item.description: Why this war has a military solution and not a diplomatic one — and why the only honest road to peace runs through arming Ukraine, exhausting Russia's war machine, and carrying the fight to military targets on Russian soil.
